author.name: have not read the C, so...

message: production, I think marx was trying to say, circumscribed an area around the worker that served as a summation of his experience.  New materials, new markets; etc.  As far as "producing" subjectivity I will not comment, but I think Marx's passage is to be taken in the literal, world-as-content/content=perception kinda way.  But hey, I'd love to see some more notes on the subject.
